in_sanskrit.name: Sharveshi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Love
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharveshi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sharveshi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva', which refers to the Hindu god of love and fertility. The suffix '-eshi' adds a feminine touch to the name, making it a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl.
